spec.title: Start the complete local app with one command
spec.problem: Starting the complete local app currently requires separate commands for the API/UI, the Trading runtime and Ollama. Add `npm run up` to launch the existing services together, reuse a reachable Ollama server, start an unavailable local Ollama server, and stop owned processes together on exit. Initial dependency installation and model downloads remain one-time setup. Keep existing commands available. Allowed files: package.json, scripts/up.mjs, backend/tests/startup.test.js, README.md, AGENTS.md.
acceptance_criteria: One command (`npm run up`) launches the API, the UI and the Trading runtime, plus Ollama when needed.
A running Ollama server is reused and left running on shutdown.
An unavailable remote Ollama server produces an actionable error.
A service failure stops the owned group of processes.
